tips.text: Buy a cheap spare Secondary such as a Lato before crafting; the foundry blocks the build if the Vipers are your only Secondaries.
Build both Vipers as weapons first; the recipe will not take a Viper blueprint.
Build both Vipers at once; they run in parallel.
Farm the Viper materials in one Mars session; Salvage, Ferrite, Nano Spores and Morphics all drop there.
Take the Orokin Cell from any boss or Sentient kill you are already running; you only need one.
Players treat it as an early Mastery pickup, good for XP and not much else.
